decision.reason: [ev-f1e311e8bf49] says only that support for headers and timeout settings was added for gRPC requests that export traces to an OpenTelemetry Collector. It does not name the configuration field or where it lives. The linked issue [ev-c95b825bbee1][ev-ef4decaae167] is a feature request. It points to the OpenTelemetry extension provider in mesh config and to Envoy's GrpcService InitialMetadata/timeout. But it only proposes "a similar field" and never states the field Istio actually added (key, path or type). The section context [ev-9c5e6c5bc8ee] does not add anything about this field. To write the subject we need the merged PR or the MeshConfig API change that names the new fields under the OpenTelemetry provider (for example, the gRPC headers and timeout keys).
